```plato

//==
// # Polylines
//
// Open and closed vertex chains
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polygonal_chain) in the plane, in space, and in
// N dimensions. The `Closed` flag decides whether the wrap-around edge from the last
// vertex back to the first counts.

// A chain of straight segments joining consecutive Points. When Closed, an
// extra segment joins the last point back to the first. At least two points.
type Polyline2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IConnected, IBounded2D, ILength, IPointSet2D, IDeformable2D
{
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}
```
